---
title: "check-links.yml"
---

Run a lychee link check with a bundled config, a PR skip-label, and an
auto-filed issue when links break on `main`.

## Inputs

| Input                  | Type    | Default                   | Description                                                                           |
| ---------------------- | ------- | ------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `lychee-config`        | string  | `''`                      | Path in the caller repo to a lychee config; falls back to the bundled default.        |
| `lychee-args`          | string  | `''`                      | Arguments and globs passed to lychee; a sensible default glob set is used when empty. Do not pass `--format` or `--output`. |
| `fail-if-empty`        | boolean | `false`                   | Fail the run when no links are found.                                                 |
| `create-issue-on-main` | boolean | `true`                    | File an issue when links break on the `main` branch.                                  |
| `skip-label`           | string  | `'links checked by hand'` | PR label that skips the link check.                                                   |
| `fail-on-any-5xx`      | boolean | `false`                   | Fail on every 5xx server error, not only on one on a line the PR adds.                |

A 404, a network error, or a timeout fails the check wherever the link is.
A 5xx server error is usually a host that is briefly down rather than a dead link,
so it fails a pull request only when the link is on a line the PR adds.
Any other 5xx is reported as a warning annotation and in the job summary,
and does not fail the run (gha#1052).
On any other event, such as a push, a scheduled run, `workflow_dispatch`,
`merge_group`, or `pull_request_target`,
the workflow passes no diff base, so every 5xx is a warning.
The `check-links` composite that this workflow calls
defaults its `base-ref` input to `all`,
so a direct caller of the composite still fails on every 5xx
unless it passes a ref or `''`.

## Permissions

Grant `issues: write`, `pull-requests: read`, and `contents: read` (it opens an
issue on `main` failures).

## Example

```yaml
# Copy to .github/workflows/check-links.yml in your repo.
# NOTE: the calling job grants issues:write so the workflow can open an issue
# when links break on main. Required because repos default to a read-only token.
name: Check Links

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, labeled, unlabeled]
  schedule:
    # Run weekly on Mondays at 9:00 UTC to catch link rot
    - cron: "0 9 * * 1"
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  check:
    permissions:
      contents: read
      issues: write
      pull-requests: read
    uses: Morrison-Lab/gha/.github/workflows/check-links.yml@v2
    # with:
    #   lychee-config: lychee.toml       # use a repo-local config instead of the bundled default
    #   fail-if-empty: true              # fail when no links are found (default: false)
    #   create-issue-on-main: true
    #   skip-label: 'links checked by hand'
    #   fail-on-any-5xx: true            # fail on every 5xx, not only on PR-added lines (@v3)
```

See
[`examples/check-links.yml`](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/blob/main/examples/check-links.yml)
for the full caller stub.
